name: Azuki Azusa
source:
Azusa is a second-year student who is very popular. . She is a loner and has rejected all of the confessions she has received. She likes animals and tends to include bizarre animal similes in conversation and owns a pet turtle as well. As a result of Youto's wish on the Stony Cat statue, she temporarily becomes unable to express her honest feelings, but later begins to open up to those around her including him for whom she starts to develop feelings. While she pretends to be a rich elite, she actually lives in a small apartment and keeps several jobs in a neighboring town - as a waitress in a maid cafe, construction worker and paper girl - in order to be able to afford the act.

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_%22Hentai%22_Prince_and_the_Stony_Cat.]Wikipedia[/url]]
